policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The combined rebased #128 and #176/#538/#550 client changes extend modal-history ownership, private navigation suppression, nested-modal accessibility, and navigation-ledger coverage in the instrumented client/core scope. Three clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-08-02 each passed all 2,011 tests across 243 files with zero unhandled errors and reproduced exactly 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). Relative to the reviewed #128 main baseline of 2,738/3,128 (87.532%), the combined tree adds 73 instrumented lines and 70 covered lines while increasing coverage percentage. The exact observed envelope needs no instrumentation tolerance, so the new floor is 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The #659 EP-04.3 slice adds registry-owned generation invocation and protected result-release leases, zero-queue per-provider bulkheads, caller/generation/deadline arbitration with fixed cooperative grace, owned runaway observation, strict bounded Alpha request/response validation, and the first real collectible Alpha Hello invocation without routes, startup workers, deployment, or Android/client production behavior. Three clean local .NET 10.0.9 Coverlet runs on 2026-08-04 against the identical final 52,590-line production source and 4,094-test scope measured 42,783, 42,786 and 42,785 covered lines. The reviewed observed high-water is therefore 42,786/52,590 (81.358%) and the exact observed floor is 42,783/52,590 (81.352%); the three-line schedule-dependent instrumentation spread is bounded to 0.006 percentage points. Relative to the #656 baseline of 41,758/51,374 (81.282%), the change adds 1,216 instrumented lines and at least 1,025 covered lines while increasing overall coverage. Focused payload-boundary, schema, authority-race, lifecycle-race, cancellation, bulkhead, peer-isolation, collectible-load-context, real-fixture and architecture tests cover the new invocation-critical paths. Circuit breakers, health probes, public gateways, SDKs, state/events and #648 killable filesystem isolation remain explicitly deferred. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
